catalog.name: home
catalog.doc:
Home the machine. Used by ``puda machine home <machine-id>``.

Returns:
    dict: Homed flag and origin position

catalog.name: move_to
catalog.doc:
Move to an absolute simulated position.

Args:
    x: Target X
    y: Target Y
    z: Target Z

Returns:
    dict: New position

safety.summary: Collision risk from unhomed motion or an occupied workspace.
safety.requires: Machine must just have been homed.
safety.forbidden_when: Do not move if the workspace is occupied or human movement is detected.

catalog.name: set_heater
catalog.doc:
Set the simulated heater temperature. Advisory safety only; no operator confirm.

Args:
    celsius: Target temperature in Celsius

Returns:
    dict: Applied setpoint

safety.summary: Thermal hazard from simulated heater power.
safety.requires: Workspace must be clear of flammable material.
safety.forbidden_when: Do not heat if a thermal interlock is active.
